preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 10
preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(N == int(line) and N >= 6 and N <= 1000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line after T is an integer N (6 ≤ N ≤ 1000) representing the number of integers on the blackboard.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the line after N contains exactly N space-separated integers A₁, A₂, ..., Aₙ (0 ≤ Aᵢ ≤ 10⁹).

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= int(num) <= 10**9 for num in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])
preconditions.description: All integers on the blackboard are non-negative and ≤ 10⁹.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == ['0'] * (T * 2) or all('\n'.join(operations) in stdout for operations in expected_operations)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output must either be a valid sequence of operations (M followed by M lines of 3 integers each) that reduces all numbers on the blackboard to 0 in ≤ 11111 operations, or a sentinel case where M=0 (only if all numbers are already 0).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(M) <= 11111 for M in [int(stdout.split()[0])] if int(stdout.split()[0]) != 0)
postconditions.description: The number of operations M for each test case must satisfy 0 ≤ M ≤ 11111.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 3 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]) if int(stdout.split()[0]) != 0 else True
postconditions.description: Each operation line must contain exactly 3 space-separated integers A, B, C.

postconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= int(num) <= 10**9 for num in line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]) if int(stdout.split()[0]) != 0 else True
postconditions.description: All integers in operation lines must be valid (0 ≤ A, B, C ≤ 10⁹).

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(num) in current_board for num in line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]) if int(stdout.split()[0]) != 0 else True
postconditions.description: For each operation, the chosen integers A, B, C must be present on the blackboard at the time of the operation. The `current_board` is the state of the blackboard after each preceding operation.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(num) == 0 for num in final_board) for final_board in final_boards)
postconditions.description: After performing all operations for a test case, all numbers on the blackboard must be 0. The `final_board` is the state after all operations are applied.
